questions.question: What is the mood of Psalm 38?
options: Quiet meditation on the works of God
Joyful praise for a very great deliverance
Confident trust in the day of battle
Penitential lament over sin and suffering
questions.answer: Penitential lament over sin and suffering

questions.question: How does David describe his iniquities?
options: Risen up like the sea, threatening at last to drown him
Gone over his head, like a heavy burden too heavy to bear
Spread out like a fire, consuming everything that he owns
Multiplied like the grains of sand upon the wide seashore
questions.answer: Gone over his head, like a heavy burden too heavy to bear
